errors.text_span: und endet im Jahr 2027 bei etwa 0,45 %
errors.evidence: The line for 'Frühjahr 2023' does not end in 2027. It extends to the end of the chart in 2029, where its value is approximately 0.4%, not 0.45%.
The line for 'Frühjahr 2024' (light blue, dashed) ends in the year 2028. It does not have a data point for 2029, so the description hallucinates the end point and value.
